0022600158.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder visit the Cleveland Cavaliers for their seventh game of the season, with both teams at 4-2 after six games. The Thunder are 1-2 on the road and riding a two-game losing streak, while the Cavaliers are 3-0 at home and have won their last game. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain). The Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 121-113 home win on February 22, 2026, and this season's series has no games yet.
